title: Restricted function is the two-bit OR
statement: Fix coordinates $2$ and $3$ to $1$ and $−1$, respectively, and let $y$ range over sign assignments to coordinates $0$ and $1$. The resulting restriction of the four-coordinate Boolean function equals, at every $y$, the two-bit OR function applied to the signs at coordinates $0$ and $1$; this OR function is $1$ exactly when both signs are $1$, and is $−1$ otherwise.
